description: This Java class handles PayPal Express Checkout integration within the OFBiz framework, including setting up checkout, redirecting to PayPal, updating checkout, retrieving checkout details, and determining checkout type based on payment settings.

classes.name: ExpressCheckoutEvents
classes.description: Handles PayPal Express Checkout processes including setup, redirect, update, details retrieval, and checkout type determination within OFBiz.

methods.name: setExpressCheckout
methods.description: Initiates the Express Checkout process by calling the appropriate PayPal service based on checkout type.

methods.name: expressCheckoutRedirect
methods.description: Redirects the user to PayPal's Express Checkout page using the stored checkout token.

methods.name: expressCheckoutUpdate
methods.description: Updates the checkout process, particularly for standard checkout type, by invoking a service.

methods.name: getExpressCheckoutDetails
methods.description: Retrieves details of the Express Checkout session from PayPal.

methods.name: doExpressCheckout
methods.description: Performs the actual Express Checkout operation, returning the result or error.

methods.name: expressCheckoutCancel
methods.description: Cancels the checkout by removing the PayPal token from the cart.

methods.name: determineCheckoutType
methods.description: Determines the checkout type (PAYFLOW, STANDARD, NONE) based on payment settings.

methods.name: determineCheckoutType
methods.description: Overloaded method that determines checkout type using delegator and product store ID.
